note: GH.16 orchestrator starts (legacy-only, no matrix cell: binding a start to code is GH.18's host-start rules). A compose service's `build:` (a context string, or a map of context / dockerfile / target) is an INFRA_REFERENCES service -> the image the Dockerfile reader names for that context's Dockerfile (worker/docker/Dockerfile.worker walks up to `worker`); its command / entrypoint (a string split with shell-word rules, a flow or block list as written) and working_dir are one CODE start cell on the service, and a service naming both `image:` and `build:` puts a build cell on the declared image. Each k8s pod-template container and initContainer with command / args / workingDir is a start cell on the workload, keyed by container name; a container that overrides nothing (the envoy sidecar) has none. A Helm `{{ }}` value is refused and counted (`[k8s-start] .. refused=2` for chart/templates/deploy.yaml), never read. Before GH.16: no service -> built-image edge (infra:service:api, api-runtime and worker had none) and no start cell on any service or workload.
